claim.quote: First results obtained in a series of test runs taken in laboratory demonstrate that we have successfully built and tested a geyser-concept bubble chamber that can be used in particle physics, especially in dark matter searches

name: MOSCAB: A geyser-concept bubble chamber to be used in a dark matter search

summary.plain: The MOSCAB team reports test runs on the surface showing that its geyser-type bubble chamber works and could be used for dark matter searches, and says it is ready to move underground.
summary.technical: Detector paper: operating principles and technical solutions of the geyser bubble chamber, with 56 test runs (about 400 h live time) of a 2 L scale-up in May and June 2017 at Milano-Bicocca.

title: MOSCAB: A geyser-concept bubble chamber to be used in a dark matter search
why_it_matters: The abstract says the team is ready to move underground for extensive data taking.
